subject: Fintegrate - Steering committee: exec sponsor & procurement next steps
messages:
From: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@fintegrate.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fintegrate - quick post-demo recap and next steps

Marissa / Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo today — helpful runthrough. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can get this to our steering committee:

- We liked Redwood's consistent latency guarantees and the routing/fallback options.
- Key internal stakeholders to include: Rajiv Menon (CTO, technical sponsor), Asha Patel (CFO, economic buyer), and Lena Brooks (Head of Security) for SOC2 / data handling questions.
- Procurement timeline: Finance/procurement will need an initial SOW + standard T&Cs to start redlines; target procurement finish in ~4–6 weeks assuming no major legal concerns.

Can you provide a short (10-slide) steering deck that summarizes architecture, security posture, commercial options (hosted vs dedicated), and proposed success criteria? Also include a pointer to any SOC 2 / security artifacts we can share with Lena.

Finally, Rajiv asked if we can schedule a 30-45 minute steering committee next week with him + Asha + Lena — proposed windows below. Let me know what works.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 3/2 10:30-11:15
- Tue 3/2 15:00-15:45
- Wed 3/3 09:00-09:45

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Thompson
Director, Platform Partnerships
Fintegrate

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@fintegrate.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fintegrate - quick post-demo recap and next steps

Sarah — thanks for the clear summary and the list of stakeholders. Really helpful. Quick responses and next steps from our side: 

1) Steering deck: I'll put together a 10–12 slide exec deck focused on: architecture & data flows, security & compliance (SOC2 summary), deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private), success metrics & recommended timeline, and commercial overview. Will share v1 by EOW (Fri 2/27).

2) Security artifacts: attaching a SOC2 overview and a short security one-pager we can surface to Lena. If Lena wants deeper artifacts we can follow the NDA process but the overview should unblock initial questions.

3) Stakeholder mapping / decision criteria: from our conversation, it sounds like
   - Economic buyer: Asha Patel (CFO) — cost model & ROI will be primary.
   - Technical sponsor: Rajiv Menon (CTO) — latency, reliability, and integration constraints.
   - Security/Compliance: Lena Brooks — SOC2 controls, data residency, KMS/HSM.
   - Procurement: will handle SOW, PO, and legal redlines.

4) Steering committee: We can do Tue 3/2 10:30 PST — Vivek and I can both join. If that doesn't work we'll default to Tue 3/2 15:00. Please confirm attendees and final slot.

Next: I'll send v1 deck + proposed agenda and a draft SOW for procurement review by EOW.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Steering committee materials + SOW draft

Hi all — looping in with a couple of practical items to keep procurement moving.

- Attached: Draft-SOW-Fintegrate.docx (baseline statement of work, includes scope, milestones, and commercial options).
- Attached: Redwood-Steering-Deck-v1.pdf (exec-friendly 11-slide deck).
- Security: SOC2 one-pager already shared; full SOC2 report is available under NDA — happy to coordinate.

Sarah — quick ask for procurement: can you share any specific contract language your legal/procurement requests (IP clauses, data retention, indemnity caps)? If you can send a short list we can get our legal team to prioritize redlines.

Agenda suggestion for steering committee (30–45m):
1) Intros & objectives (5m)
2) Architecture & integration approach (10m)
3) Security & compliance (10m)
4) Commercials / deployment options (10m)
5) Next steps & procurement timeline (5–10m)

Thanks — Vivek and I will be prepared to walk through the deck.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, GTM Solutions

Team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the materials. A few notes from our side:

- Confirming attendees: Rajiv (CTO) will join, Asha (CFO) can join for first 20 mins for commercial discussion, Lena (Head of Security) will join. Procurement/legal will be on stand-by to pick up SOW redlines.
- Preferred slot: Tue 3/2 10:30–11:15 PST works for the execs. Please send calendar invite to that slot.
- Procurement asks: we have a standard set of redline requests around data residency, subprocessor list, and third-party audit frequency — I can pass those to you by EOD Mon 3/1.
- DocuSign/PO: Once SOW is agreed, procurement will issue a PO. We use DocuSign for our internal approvals — I'll share the PO template link when we're at that stage.
